f-a11y.1.evidence: Guest on /community/: first Tab lands on 'Skip to content' (visible at top 11px); Enter -> URL #content, and the next Tab lands on the community nav inside #content.

f-a11y.2.evidence: bob, Reign, light and dark (dark via the Reign toggle): 45-60 Tab stops on /community/, a space listing and a topic; every Jetonomy and Reign control has an outline (2px) or box-shadow, measured 220ms after focus; no positive tabindex, DOM order = reading order. Only exceptions are WordPress core admin-bar items (search input, adminbar links with a transparent outline colour), not Jetonomy or theme. BuddyX/TT25 not repeated (check not tagged +long/+390).

f-a11y.3.evidence: Topic, composer and header: no visible button without an accessible name; theme toggle 'Light mode (click to switch to dark)' with aria-pressed, font-size buttons aria-pressed, Notifications aria-expanded, Share aria-expanded, Bookmark aria-pressed, Vote up/down aria-pressed (label flips to 'Remove your upvote'), More options aria-expanded + aria-haspopup=menu, composer toolbar buttons labelled (Bold, Italic, Code, Code block, Link, Blockquote, Upload image, Insert emoji). With Pro Anonymous Posting on and the space opted in, the composer shows a native checkbox labelled 'Post anonymously' (name from its visible label; checked state native).

f-a11y.4.evidence: New topic: editor is role=textbox aria-multiline=true aria-labelledby the visible 'Content' label; title input has label 'Title'; reply editor role=textbox aria-label 'Reply editor'. Poll option inputs expose the names 'Option 1' / 'Option 2' (via their placeholder; there is no aria-label or <label>), the question has a label. Note for 2.0.8: a placeholder-only name is weak.

f-a11y.5.evidence: Vote cluster is role=group labelled 'Votes: <score>', vote buttons carry aria-pressed and a flipping label ('Vote up' / 'Remove your upvote'). Pro reaction chips: server-rendered chip is a button with sr-only text 'Love', aria-hidden emoji and the count -> accessible name 'Love 2', aria-pressed=false/true; the chip created the moment I reacted (Rocket) is 'Rocket 1' with aria-pressed=true and is-mine.

f-a11y.6.evidence: Report on a reply (keyboard Enter): role=dialog aria-modal=true labelled 'Why are you reporting this reply?' containing role=radiogroup with the same label (5 reasons); focus lands on the first radio (spam); 10 Tabs stay inside the dialog; Escape closes it and focus returns to the Report control in the same reply.

f-a11y.7.evidence: test_moderator: Flags buttons 'Uphold'/'Dismiss' aria-describedby the target author; Awaiting approval buttons 'Approve'/'Spam' and Trash buttons 'Restore'/'Delete permanently' aria-describedby the content title; Review in queue links aria-describedby the flagged excerpt/title; Approve is reachable by Tab (59 stops from the top); Mark spam opens a real role=dialog aria-modal 'Mark this submission as spam?...' with focus on Cancel and no native alert/confirm; Escape closes it.

f-a11y.8.evidence: Share: Space and Enter open it, focus moves to Copy link, ArrowDown moves Twitter/X then Facebook, Escape closes and focus returns to the Share button. Notification panel: Enter and Space open it (aria-expanded true), focus goes into the panel, ArrowDown moves between items, Escape closes and focus returns to the Notifications button.

f-a11y.9.evidence: Scripted contrast scan of every text element inside .jt-app on /community/, Announcements listing, a closed Announcement topic (Closed label), a topic and New topic, light and dark: 0 elements under 4.5:1 (3:1 large); placeholders 7.3-21:1 light, 7.7-12:1 dark; 'Content hidden because you blocked this user.' 6.32:1 light / 7.78:1 dark.

f-a11y.10.evidence: 390px touch context (hasTouch+isMobile, hover:none): no horizontal overflow on topic, space, home and new topic; the 'Hide replies' toggle and every other Jetonomy button, input and select are >= 40px, EXCEPT the Pro reaction chips on the topic page: .jt-reaction-chip ('Love 2', 'Rocket 1') are 62x32px. 200% zoom emulated at 195 CSS px: scrollWidth 195 == clientWidth. Desktop 1440: A++ (Extra large) takes post body 17 -> 19.2px, h1 25.5 -> 28.8px, community nav 15.9 -> 18px, persists after reload (data-bn-font-scale 120), Reign header font stays 36px/17px and A resets. Read: product bug (small, Pro Reactions only): chip height 32px under the 40px tap-target the line demands. Text links (breadcrumb, author names, permalinks, in-reply-to, 30px avatar links) are 17-30px high; I treated those as inline text links, not controls.

f-a11y.11.evidence: Bookmark toast is div role=status aria-live=polite ('Bookmarked'). Poll builder error (question filled, options empty): 'Question and at least 2 options required.' is in a role=alert region jt-field-error-1, the first empty poll_options[] input has aria-invalid=true and aria-describedby=jt-field-error-1, and it gets focus. 'Badge awarded.' is shown through jetonomyAlert, a real role=dialog (focus moves in). But 'Reaction settings saved.' (Settings > Reactions) is a plain server-rendered WP admin notice (div.notice.notice-success.settings-error, no role, no aria-live) and WordPress's a11y-speak polite/assertive regions stayed empty, so it is not announced through a live region. Read: low-severity product gap on a wp-admin settings notice (or a stale expectation: the core settings-error pattern); main session decides.

f-a11y.15.evidence: bob's profile (a badge + custom field 'Film camera' = Pentax K1000, created with the Custom Fields extension): h1 Bob Martinez, h2 Badges, h2 Profile Details, then sidebar h2s, no skipped level; Edit Profile: h1 Edit Profile, h2 More about you; New topic with the poll builder open (Pro polls on): h1 New Topic, h2 Poll.

f-a11y.12.evidence: finn (silenced) on a topic and /new/: no composer is rendered; 'Your account is currently silenced and cannot post.' is a text notice in reading order (not colour only); REST posting gives 403 jetonomy_user_silenced.

f-a11y.13.evidence: Topic, profile, space and new-topic pages: <nav aria-label=Breadcrumb> with the current crumb aria-current=page (topic title, Alice Chen, Feature Requests, New Topic); exactly one h1 on each; heading levels never skip.

f-a11y.14.evidence: Arabic (html dir=rtl), keyboard only as bob: Tab (95 stops) to Vote up on a reply + Enter (aria-pressed true); Tab to Report, Enter, Space on the first reason, Tab to the submit, Enter -> POST /flags 201; Tab into the reply editor, typed Arabic, Tab to Post Reply, Enter -> POST replies 201; Tab to title, editor, Post Topic, Enter -> POST topic 201. No pointer used. Test flag, reply and topic removed; language restored.

f-a11y.16.evidence: bob > Edit Profile notification preferences: 18 toggles, 18 unique non-empty names ('Reply to my topic Web', 'Reply to my topic Email', 'Reply to my reply Web', ...).

f-a11y.17.evidence: Keyboard on a moderated topic: Enter on More options opens a role=menu (aria-haspopup=menu, aria-expanded true) with menuitem children (Edit, Make Private, Pin to space, Close topic, Move, Merge, Delete), focus goes to the first item, ArrowDown moves, Escape closes and focus returns to the trigger. Review in queue links on /community/mod/ carry aria-describedby ids naming the flagged excerpt/title.
